senses.gloss: to explain the meaning of information, words, or actions

definition_translations.zh_TW: 解釋資訊、話語或行動的意義
definition_translations.ja_JP: 情報、言葉、または行動の意味を説明する
definition_translations.ko_KR: 정보, 말 또는 행동의 의미를 설명하다
definition_translations.vi_VN: giải thích ý nghĩa của thông tin, lời nói hoặc hành động
definition_translations.th_TH: อธิบายความหมายของข้อมูล คำพูด หรือการกระทำ

senses.gloss: to translate spoken language from one language into another
senses.example: A bilingual assistant interpreted during the negotiations.

translations.th_TH: แปลภาษาพูด

example_translations.zh_TW: 一位雙語助理在談判期間擔任口譯。

definition_translations.vi_VN: dịch lời nói từ ngôn ngữ này sang ngôn ngữ khác
definition_translations.th_TH: แปลภาษาพูดจากภาษาหนึ่งเป็นอีกภาษาหนึ่ง
